solutions.check: grid and clues read from the FT's printable PDF, its numbering matching the clue list; every fifteensquared answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Seat in van? No

definitions.meaning: the seat is the part of the body one sits on, the buttocks
the van is the front, so not in the van means at the back of things

explanation.walkthrough: 'van' here is short for vanguard, the leading position, not a vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: A colloquial word for the buttocks is also the adverb for being at the rear, so both readings fit.

clue.text: Panda giving a turn in cabaret

indicators.note: a turn is a twist, so the letters of the word are turned into a new order

explanation.surface: A panda gives a performance in a nightclub show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a turn' looks like a stage act in the cabaret, but it signals rearranging its letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The red panda is also known as the cat-bear or bearcat.

clue.text: Powerless to get substandard player suspended

parts.note: a ham is a bad, overacting performer
strung up means hung or suspended

explanation.surface: A poor footballer is dropped and left unable to act.
explanation.definitionFit: Hamstrung, literally lamed by a cut tendon, figuratively means rendered helpless or powerless.

clue.text: Untidy arrangement that would horrify Mrs Grundy

indicators.note: an arrangement of the word gives a new order of its letters

explanation.surface: A messy home would shock a prudish neighbour.
explanation.walkthrough: Mrs Grundy is a stock name for a narrow-minded prude, from an 18th-century play.
explanation.definitionFit: Nakedness is exactly the kind of impropriety that would shock a prudish moralist.

clue.text: Helps to define the goal of angry lawyers

parts.note: angry means cross
the Bar is the collective term for barristers

explanation.surface: Furious lawyers somehow help decide a match's target.
explanation.definitionFit: The horizontal bar joining the posts marks the top of a football or rugby goal.

clue.text: Switch round a route

indicators.note: round means the stick goes around the next letter

parts.note: a switch is a thin stick or rod

explanation.surface: Change direction around one particular way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Switch round' suggests reversal, but 'Switch' is ROD going 'round' A.
explanation.definitionFit: A road is a way from one place to another, a route.

clue.text: The fate of criminals in so many words

definitions.meaning: the punishment a judge hands down
a grammatical unit made of a group of words

explanation.definitionFit: It means both a court's punishment and a complete grammatical unit of words.

clue.text: Note the arrangements of sails in vessels

parts.note: B is a musical note
a ship's rig is the arrangement of its masts and sails

explanation.surface: Observe how the sails are set on the ships.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Note' looks like an instruction to observe but supplies the musical note B.
explanation.definitionFit: Brigs are two-masted square-rigged sailing ships, a kind of vessel.

clue.text: Treatment received by troops losing Turkish capital

indicators.note: losing means that something is dropped from the troops

parts.note: a regiment is a body of troops

indicators.note: the capital of the word is its opening letter

explanation.surface: Soldiers given medical care after their capital in Turkey falls.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turkish capital' suggests Ankara but is just the letter T.
explanation.definitionFit: A regimen is a prescribed course of medical treatment or diet.

clue.text: An English bowler knocked it for six

definitions.text: An English bowler knocked it for six

parts.words: An English bowler knocked it for six
parts.note: Drake, famously playing bowls at Plymouth, went on to rout the Spanish invasion fleet of 1588

explanation.walkthrough: 'knocked it for six' is cricket slang for overwhelming something; the bowler is Sir Francis Drake, said to have finished his game of bowls before sailing.
explanation.definitionFit: The Spanish fleet sent against England in 1588 was defeated under Drake's command.

clue.text: A show of spirit is difficult to forget

definitions.meaning: the appearance of a ghost in a place
memorably evocative, lingering in the mind

explanation.definitionFit: The noun names a ghost's visitation and the adjective describes a memory that will not go away.

clue.text: Attention in class — get prepared for action

indicators.note: in means the first item goes inside the second

parts.note: a form is a school class
to give ear is to pay attention

explanation.surface: Pay attention in the classroom and be ready to act.
explanation.definitionFit: To forearm is to arm or ready oneself in advance, as in forewarned is forearmed.

clue.text: A tonic it may be, getting a mention in dispatches

indicators.note: says the letters of the phrase may become something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: A boost to morale comes from being praised in military reports.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may be' signals rearranging A TONIC IT.
explanation.definitionFit: A citation is the formal commendation of a soldier named in dispatches for bravery.

clue.text: Fast movers, before morning found at sea

indicators.note: the first piece comes before the second

parts.note: jets are fast aircraft

explanation.surface: Speedy craft out before dawn turn up on the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: Jetsam is cargo thrown overboard, which is then found floating or washed ashore.

clue.text: Levelling out and gliding

definitions.meaning: smoothing creases flat, as with a hot iron on clothes
moving smoothly over a surface, as the iron does over cloth

explanation.definitionFit: Pressing laundry flattens it, and the iron slides smoothly across the fabric while doing it.

clue.text: Right to put junction on road in France

parts.note: a T-junction, abbreviated to its letter T
rue is French for street

explanation.surface: Is it correct to build a crossroads on a French street?
explanation.definitionFit: Right and true are synonyms meaning correct or accurate.

clue.text: Light diversion?

parts.note: reads as some easy entertainment but means rays of light being bent off course

explanation.walkthrough: 'Light diversion' usually means a bit of fun; here it is optics, light changing direction as it enters glass or water.
explanation.definitionFit: The bending of a light ray passing between media is literally a diversion of light.

clue.text: Very fit position for a prospective school-leaver?

definitions.meaning: in excellent condition, physically at one's best
a pupil about to leave school is in the highest class or form

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means at peak condition, and literally a final-year pupil sits in the highest form.

clue.text: Judgement I consider not right to modify

indicators.note: to modify means to change the order of the letters
not means a letter is left out of the word

parts.note: taken as the word itself

explanation.surface: A ruling the speaker thinks wrong should be amended.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not right' drops R from CONSIDER, giving ICONSIDE, and 'to modify' rearranges those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A decision is a judgement reached after consideration.

clue.text: An impressive thing to wear

parts.note: impressive here means making an impression, as a seal pressed into wax

explanation.walkthrough: 'impressive' looks like praise but means something used to press a mark into wax.
explanation.definitionFit: A finger ring carrying an engraved seal was used to stamp wax on letters.

clue.text: Objection has little weight

definitions.meaning: a moral qualm that holds one back
an old apothecaries' unit of twenty grains

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a moral hesitation and a tiny apothecaries' weight.

clue.text: A way the old can show complaint

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
ye is an archaic spelling of the, as in ye olde

explanation.surface: Old folk have a particular way of grumbling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the old' means an old form of the word the: YE.
explanation.definitionFit: A stye is a small eye infection, and complaint is a word for an ailment.

clue.text: Basic part of an electric kettle

definitions.text: Basic part of an electric kettle

parts.words: Basic part of an electric kettle
parts.note: a fundamental constituent, and specifically the coil that heats the water

explanation.definitionFit: The heating coil in a kettle is called this, and it also means a basic constituent.

clue.text: To be consistent he must be in the middle

indicators.note: must be in means the pronoun goes inside the next piece

parts.note: the core is the middle of something

explanation.surface: For consistency, he must sit at the centre.
explanation.definitionFit: To cohere is to hold together logically, to be consistent.

clue.text: A binding affair, perhaps

indicators.note: suggests the word affair might be rearranged into something else

explanation.surface: A marriage, it may be, is a binding arrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Raffia is palm fibre used as a tying material by gardeners and craftspeople.

clue.text: The power of a waterfall

definitions.meaning: in northern England a ... is a waterfall, from Norse foss

explanation.walkthrough: In the Lake District and Yorkshire Dales, waterfalls are called forces, as in High Force.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means strength, and in northern English dialect it is a name for a waterfall.

clue.text: Stumbling upon clue for "disconnect"

indicators.note: stumbling suggests the letters of the two words are tripped into a new order

explanation.surface: A solver stumbles across a clue whose answer is disconnect.
explanation.definitionFit: To uncouple is to separate linked things, such as railway carriages, which is to disconnect them.

clue.text: Opening for a machine operator

parts.note: the gap where a coin goes to work a coin-operated machine

explanation.definitionFit: The narrow opening for coins gives its name to the coin-operated gaming machine.

clue.text: Piano piece — a very small one

parts.note: p is the musical abbreviation for piano, softly
an article is a piece of writing or an item

explanation.surface: A piano composition, rather a short one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one' in the definition refers back to 'piece', so the definition reads 'a very small piece'.
explanation.definitionFit: A particle is a tiny fragment, a minute piece of matter.

clue.text: Ask an individual to make himself scarce

definitions.text: Ask an individual to make himself scarce

parts.note: to beg is to ask earnestly
one is a single individual

explanation.surface: Politely request someone to go away.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both wordplay and definition: the word itself is an order telling someone to leave.
explanation.definitionFit: The exclamation is an old-fashioned command telling someone to go away at once.

clue.text: You never come to the end of this sort of ring

definitions.text: You never come to the end of this sort of ring

parts.words: You never come to the end of this sort of ring
parts.note: describes endless time, and also a ring set with stones all round the band

explanation.definitionFit: Endless time has no conclusion, and the gem-set band symbolising it is a familiar jeweller's term.

clue.text: Let pass

definitions.meaning: a document granting entry or passage

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means allow, and as a noun it is an authorisation like a pass.
